text:
Rooster Petroleum has successfully completed permanent abandonment operations of the VR 175 A01 well.  The current completion interval in the well, the"P" sand existing perforations, 5831' - 5433' were previous sqz'd with cmt on 07-13-04, leaving ETOC in the 2 7/8" prod. tbg @ 5330' MD.  A TTCIBP was set in the 2 7/8" prod. tbg @ 5275' and 20' of cmt dumped on top, ETOC @ 5255' MD.  The 2 7/8" prod. tbg was perforated @ 2050' MD & a 329' cmt plug set in the 
2 7/8" prod. tbg & 7 5/8" csg, 2050' - 1721' MD.  The cmt plug was tested to 1000 psi & tagged @ 1687' MD.  

2 7/8" prod. tbg was cut & pulled @ 517'.  The 7 5/8" csg was cut & pulled @ 477' MD.  A CIBP was set in the 10 3/4" csg @ 474' MD & 206' cmt plug set in the 10 3/4" csg, 474' - 268 MD. The cmt plug was tagged @ 268'.

10 3/4" csg was cut & pulled @ 227' MD (37' BML) and the 24" drive pipe was cut & pulled @ 219' MD (25' BML).

Operations began on 08-09-11 and were concluded on 08-17-11.  Note, 48" well support caisson will be cut & removed at a later date when the structure is removed.
